seo_description: Sampler plugin built in C++/JUCE with granular synthesis, custom tremolo DSP, zero-delay filters, and compressor. VST3 and AU.
hero.title: Audio
hero.subtitle: Q
hero.desc: A sampler plugin I built in C++/JUCE. Granular synthesis, hand-coded tremolo, zero-delay filters, compressor. Everything is DAW-automatable.
features.title: What It Does
features.subtitle: I built this to solve problems I had making music. Everything here is something I actually use.
features.granular.title: Granular Synthesis
features.granular.desc: Chops audio into tiny grains and plays them back with randomization. Good for ambient textures and weird sound design. Adjust grain size, position randomization, and crossfade smoothing in real-time.
features.tremolo.title: Custom Tremolo DSP
features.tremolo.desc: Hand-coded per-sample sine LFO for amplitude modulation. Sounds way better than just automating volume. Rate and depth respond instantly.
features.filters.title: Zero-Delay Filters
features.filters.desc: High-pass and low-pass TPT filters from JUCE. Zero-delay design means instant response with no artifacts. Full 20Hz-20kHz range.
features.tempo.title: Tempo Control
features.tempo.desc: Speed up or slow down samples from 20-300 BPM using JUCE's ResamplingAudioSource. Extreme time-stretching creates weird artifacts. Custom loop regions to isolate specific sections.
features.safety.title: Volume Safety
features.safety.desc: Stops playback when peaks exceed safe levels. Saved my headphones during testing. Prevents feedback loops and clipping.
features.automation.title: Full DAW Automation
features.automation.desc: Every parameter is automatable. AudioProcessorValueTreeState keeps DAW session state saved. Set a parameter, save your project, reopen — everything's where you left it.
architecture.title: Plugin Architecture
architecture.apvts.title: Parameter System (APVTS)
architecture.apvts.desc: Manages all plugin parameters and handles DAW automation. AudioProcessorValueTreeState provides thread-safe atomic access — no locks on the audio thread. Remembers settings between sessions.
architecture.process.title: Real-time Process Block
architecture.process.desc: Main audio callback invoked by the DAW. Reads parameters lock-free, fills buffer from the file player, applies filters, compressor, and tremolo sequentially. Low latency with correct effect ordering.
architecture.player.title: Audio File Player
architecture.player.desc: Handles file loading, playback, looping, and tempo control. AudioFormatReaderSource wrapped in ResamplingAudioSource for speed changes, connected to AudioTransportSource for transport controls.
challenges.title: Challenges & Solutions
challenges.c1_problem: DAW audio callback has strict real-time constraints — any lock or allocation causes audio dropouts.
challenges.c1_solution: Used APVTS for lock-free parameter access via atomic pointers. No heap allocations in processBlock. All DSP state pre-allocated in prepareToPlay.
challenges.c2_problem: Grain boundaries caused clicks and pops. Abrupt cuts between grains produced harsh artifacts.
challenges.c2_solution: Added crossfade smoothing between grains with adjustable overlap. Position randomization breaks up repetitive patterns. Result: smooth ambient textures without clicks.
challenges.c3_problem: Extreme tempo and granular settings sometimes produced unexpected volume spikes that could damage speakers or hearing.
challenges.c3_solution: Built a safety system that monitors peak levels and auto-stops playback when thresholds are exceeded. Saved my headphones more than once during development.
